doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth year 1931, not 1932
summary: The 1932 birth year came from a competitive exchange with Donald Byrd in front of Ira Gitler; McLean was born in 1931.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Is it ’31? I read ’31. I read ’32.

’32 was a farce. That didn’t really happen. I just happened to be – the story behind that is this: Donald Byrd and I are competitive musicians. We compete with each other all the time. So we were at a record date, and Ira Gitler was there. He asked Donald what year he was born, and Donald said 1932. Then Ira said, “What year were you born?” I didn’t want to be older than him. So I said I was born in ’32 as well, and it went down. That was it.
Yeah, that fiction – I saw ’31 in maybe one of the early things I got, and then I started seeing ’32.
